entry.title: Houston Astros staff and front office: The Astros are hiring Nate Irving as an assistant hitting coach, source tells @theathletic.com.Irving, 34, has spent the past two seasons in the New York Mets organization and was Triple-A Syracuse's hitting coach last year. First: @joelsherman.bsky.social

Taylor Trammell: Taylor Trammell started more games than any Astro in left field last season. Non-tendering him on Friday accentuates just how much Houston must reimagine its entire outfield - www.nytimes.com/athletic/779...

Houston Astros offseason notes: The Astros officially non-tendered Taylor Trammell. Their six other arb-eligible players were tendered: Jeremy Peña, Hunter Brown, Yainer Diaz, Peter Lambert and Hayden Wesneski. Bennett Sousa and Nick Allen also agreed to terms, avoiding arbitration.
Jackson Nezuh: The Astros added pitcher Jackson Nezuh to their 40-man roster, protecting him from the Rule 5 draft. Joey Loperfido cleared outright waivers and will go to Triple-A Sugar Land.

Joey Loperfido: The Astros placed outfielder Joey Loperfido on outright waivers, multiple sources tell @theathletic.com. Loperfido had offseason surgery on his right hip and, according to the Astros, wasn't expected to be ready for the beginning of spring training.
Yordan Álvarez: Astros designated hitter Yordan Alvarez is the American League MVP. He is the first full-time designated hitter to ever win AL MVP and the third MVP in Astros franchise history.
Isaac Paredes: The Astros exercised Isaac Paredes’ $13.35 million club option.
Tatsuya Imai: Tatsuya Imai will exercise his $18 million player option and return to the Astros in 2027, source tells @theathletic.com. First: @jonheyman.bsky.social - www.nytimes.com/athletic/773...
Nelson Velázquez: The Astros announced they released Nelson Velázquez so he could pursue an opportunity with a club in Asia.
